constraints.description: A page with an empty title cannot contain the URL domain in its title.
constraints.rationale: The domain-in-title indicator is inverted: an empty title necessarily lacks the registered-domain label, so empty_title=1 implies domain_in_title=1; nonempty titles may or may not contain the domain.

constraints.description: External redirects are a subset of total redirects.
constraints.rationale: By definition, nb_external_redirection counts redirects to a different registered domain and therefore can occur only when at least one total redirect occurred; zero external redirects permits any observed total redirect count.
